name: Leomon
main_effect: [When Attacking] If attacking a Digimon with DP higher than this Digimon, this Digimon may digivolve into 1 level 6 Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in your hand for a cost of 6, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
source_effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Leomon] in its name, it gets +2000 DP.
